commits.author: Jeffrey Doto
commits.message:
Add MAVEN_OPTS arg, data type change (#5)

* Change type of cache metrics from int to long

* Add MAVEN_OPTS arg

This commit allows the user building this container to provide proxy
configuration to maven.  For instance:

	docker build -t apache-traffic-server-exporter --build-arg MAVEN_ARGS="-Dhttp.proxyHost=proxy -Dhttp.proxyPort=1234 -Dhttps.proxyHost=proxy -Dhttps.proxyPort=1234" .

If no --build-arg parameters are provided, the original, default maven
configuration applies.
